name: Troglodyte
printedArtCredit: p. 246; signed SW, consistent with Sam Wood in the interior art credits.
sourceDistinctions: Underdark points to the 3.5 Monster Manual racial traits and confirms 2 racial Hit Dice, LA +2, favored class Cleric, and ECL 4.
The printed monster uses Fortitude DC 13 with Constitution 14. The character builds recalculate the DC from Constitution using the core racial special ability formula.
A successful save protects against the specific troglodyte for 24 hours. Poison immunity and resistance apply, and the entry names delay poison and neutralize poison as remedies.
The playable entry gives bonus Multiattack and one racial-Hit-Die feat to choose. Weapon Focus (javelin) is a feat on the printed monster, rather than a separate racial grant.
No relevant correction appears in the core errata or official FAQ.
portraitForm: Sethrik Chalkscale, an original Troglodyte cistern guide
